notes: The Skeptic's SAT searches (without certificates) find that every model of 677 of order <= 10 is a quasigroup, so a finite model of 677 that is not right-cancellative has order >= 11 (reviews/skeptic_batch1.1.md section 2.6).
novelty_basis: A two-line consequence of the law (as for left translations, ETP blueprint Lemma 13.1 for 677); not checked against the quasigroup literature.
proof_check: Lean 4 (complete) - law1313_left_bijective, law1313_right_bijective, law677_left_bijective (proofs/lean/Infinity/C05_Law1313.lean, standard axioms only); the statement about non-right-cancellative models of 677 is cited from the ETP blueprint, not proved here
statement: In every finite magma satisfying x = y(((yx)x)y) (ETP 1313), all left and all right translations are bijections, so the Cayley table is a Latin square. For law 677 the left translations are bijections; finite models of 677 that are not right-cancellative exist (ETP blueprint, equation 677 chapter, section 13.1).
title: Finite models of law 1313 are quasigroups (Lean)
